$\mu_k,r_k,\sigma_k,g_k$ & Center-window mean, residual, annular RMS, and normal-fitting feature gain. \\

$g_N,g_E,\widetilde g_N$ & Synthetic gradient, real gradient, and conflict-adjusted synthetic gradient. \\
$s_G,s_A;z_G,z_A$ & Top49 branch scores and category-standardized calibration scores. \\
$b_G,w_G;\eta_G$ & Surface intercept and nonnegative slope; calibrated surface logit. \\
$\alpha,\eta_F,p_F$ & Nonnegative appearance coefficient, corrected logit, and sigmoid probability. \\
$K,n_{cl}$ & Category count and category/label-stratum size in the current fitting or evaluation partition. \\
$n_C;f,f_A$ & Fitting-partition size; calibration regularization factors. \\
$R;T_1,T_2,T_C$ & Training-run count; normal, mixed, and appearance-continuation update budgets. \\
